notes.title: FINAL DAYS of the Puzzle Strike 2 Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Just a quick reminder that the Kickstarter for Puzzle Strike 2 (physical board game) ends in just TWO DAYS!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11248652/ce74abfb23521cf9fa58f70ec9e800a8a44d0cba.jpg[/img]

We're at just over 1000 backers and 200% funded and are looking to finish our campaign strong!

In Puzzle Strike 2, players build their deck as they play, giving them the tools to arrange and manipulate their set of colored gems. These gems can be “crashed” (destroyed) in order to build up power for four different super moves as well as to flood other players with more gems. As this process unfolds, gems will fly back and forth between players as they desperately try to remain under the threshold of corruption. Holding the scepter “helps,” but can also doom the greedy.

Thanks again to everyone who's already supported the game. If you'd like to take a closer look, check it out [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sirlin/puzzle-strike-2]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11248652/fed9fb5cc6983a55f4c394f54492569bab630399.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Yomi and Puzzle Strike are 70% off during the Steam Digital Tabletop Fest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11248652/00b66642c57ccff70f8d71fff383f412ac5569b5.png[/img]

Board Game Night is back with the [b]Steam Digital Tabletop Fest![/b]

From [b]October 21st until October 26th[/b] you can save [b]70%[/b] on our digital versions of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/287960/Yomi/]Yomi[/url] (our fighting-game-in-card-form), [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/386740/Puzzle_Strike/]Puzzle Strike[/url] (a competitive deckbuilding game with high interaction) and their DLCs.

Interested in more tabletop goodness? Check out David Sirlin’s [url=https://www.patreon.com/sirlin]Patreon[/url] page, where about twice a month we’re giving our Patrons a behind-the-scenes look at the two tabletop games we’re working on right now! If you’re a longtime fan of [b]Yomi[/b] and [b]Puzzle Strike[/b], the Patreon is the best way to support us while also gaining access to some awesome new content. 

It’s great that we can still get together for board games over the internet, even when we can’t be together in person. Be sure to support your favorite indie developers during the sale and we’ll see you all online!

Stay safe everyone!

notes.title: 2016-01-08 update: Quick Match fixes
notes.notes:
Here are the patch notes for today's Puzzle Strike update:

- Fixed various Quick Match-related bugs
- Fixed a Puzzlebot hang when playing Wartime Tactics while Sale Prices is active
- The Cancel button on the initial character select screen of a QM or "Practice vs CPU" game now properly quits back to the main manu
- Fixed Midori Puzzlebot's Dragon Form often deactivating after the bot does a counter-crash

I'm not sure whether this fixes all known Puzzle Strike QM bugs. Those are really hard to test though, so if you see some more glitchy QMs, I'd like to know about it.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: 2015-01-05 update
notes.notes:
Here are the details on today's Puzzle Strike update:

- Puzzle Strike now supports new currencies in the Steam store: CHF CNY INR CLP PEN COP ZAR HKD TWD SAR AED
- Windows, Mac, Linux: Fixed some cases of bad resolutions when starting the game in fullscreen
- Mac: Fixed occasional game crash when starting the game in fullscreen then hitting Cmd-F to switch to windowed mode
- Puzzle Smash: Big Rocks and Risky Move now work as expected with 5-gems present
- New Quick Match games now start the "Practice vs AI while waiting" game with a random bank, rather than with the default bank
- Fixed some chat bubbles pointing the wrong way
